infotexts.loadingscreentip: [ERC Donjon] Don't forget to plow your crops with a hoe or pickaxe, otherwise they will quickly perish!
[ERC Donjon] Healing potions can only be applied while held in hand.
[ERC Donjon] Sharp weapons like falchions are extremely effective against unarmored people and creatures, but will only make armored warriors laugh.
[ERC Donjon] To extract resources from ore, you simply need to smash it with a pickaxe or something else.
[ERC Donjon] Knowledge of Magic is rare, but you can always overhear someone else saying spells and do the same.
[ERC Donjon] To brew potions, you'll need a cauldron, a distiller, and knowledge of potion recipes, such as those found in a potion-making book.
[ERC Donjon] Bows and crossbows deal significantly more headshot damage.
[ERC Donjon] Rusty and unwanted items can always be smelted into metal in a forge.
[ERC Donjon] To obtain bone meal or plant seeds, you'll need a mortar and pestle.
[ERC Donjon] Boars are a good source of food and materials, but be careful - if cornered, they will fight to the death.
[ERC Donjon] Hitting small tree saplings with a stone will get you sticks for your first axe much faster than hitting a large or young tree.
[ERC Donjon] Spears are considered ranged weapons and receive a corresponding damage bonus from potions and perks.
[ERC Donjon] Food spoils quickly, but almost any food can be processed into a less filling, but indefinitely stored version.
[ERC Donjon] If you want to give a healing potion to an ally, they must be lying on the ground, and the potion must be in their hands, whether you or your ally.
[ERC Donjon] Obtaining your first forge can be a very difficult process. It makes sense to find alternative sources of iron before smelting it in the forge, such as lapis lazuli or boulders.

infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmetredwrecked: An uncomfortable and rusty helmet. Despite its condition, it still offers fairly good protection. Beyond repair.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmetlight_wrecke: A rusty cauldron on the head that can hardly be called a helmet. Beyond repair.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmet_visor: An excellent helmet that covers the top of the head and face. The visor is particularly effective against thrusts. It slightly reduce vision and combat speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmet_visor2: A high-quality helmet that covers the top of the head and face. The visor is particularly effective against thrusts. It slightly reduce vision and combat speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmet_salad: A sheet metal helmet that covers the head and part of the face. It slightly limits vision but doesn't slow you down much.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmeteast_visor: Decorated helmet with visor. Will slightly limit your vision.
infotexts.entitydescription.cannon_erc: It must be pre-set on the map. Currently can be rotated only via vanilla electronics.
infotexts.entitydescription.cannon_erc_movable: A formidable weapon used against the most robust fortresses. Mounted on a wheeled carriage and ready to roll.
infotexts.entitydescription.cannon_unfinished_1: A wooden base for mounting a cannon. It still requires four sturdy wheels and the cannon itself. Never move a fully loaded cannon!
infotexts.entitydescription.cannon_unfinished_2: A massive iron cannon barrel. Incredibly heavy — it must be transported either directly on the carriage or in a wagon; it is too heavy to carry by hand!
infotexts.entitydescription.cannonball_erc: Very big stone ball used to shoot from cannon.
infotexts.entitydescription.wreckplatearmorerc: Ancient torso armor that was once nearly impenetrable. Not very durable and cannot be repaired.
infotexts.entitydescription.wreckplatearmor2erc: Ancient limb armor that was once nearly impenetrable. Not very durable and cannot be repaired.
infotexts.entitydescription.goblinarmor_erc: Armor made of rope, leaves, and hides. Goblins probably use those for hunting.
infotexts.entitydescription.goblinhelmet_erc: Helmet made of rope, leaves, and hides. Conceals the face and generally makes you more stealthy.
infotexts.entitydescription.idcardcontainer_mediev: Useful for storing coins, keys, or papers.
infotexts.entitydescription.toolbelt_medieval: Leather pockets for various items. Lantern can be mounted on it.
infotexts.entitydescription.quiver_medieval: A bag for arrows or crossbow bolts.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmormagic: This armor is incredibly durable and conceals some sort of malevolent aura.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmormagic2: This armor is incredibly durable and conceals some sort of malevolent aura.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorelite: Heavy, expensive chest, stomach, and shoulder armor made of high-quality metal. Impenetrable to bites and cuts.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorelite2: Heavy, expensive limb armor made of high-quality metal. Impenetrable to bites and cuts.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorerc: Heavy chest, stomach, and shoulder armor made of high-quality metal. Practically impenetrable to bites and cuts.
infotexts.entitydescription.lightplatearmorerc: Lightweight armor with a cloak that protects the chest, stomach, and shoulders.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmor_decora: Heavy armor for the chest, stomach, and shoulders made of high-quality metal. This one has blue heraldry.
Heavy armor for the chest, stomach, and shoulders made of high-quality metal. This one has red heraldry.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmor2erc: Heavy limb armor made of high-quality metal. Practically impenetrable to bites and cuts.
infotexts.entityname.steelplatearmor2_decorated_er: Decorated Blue Steel Plate Greaves and Bracers
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmor2_decor: Heavy limb armor made of high-quality metal. With blue heraldry and decorations.
infotexts.entityname.steelplatearmor2_decorated_re: Decorated Red Steel Plate Greaves and Bracers
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmor2_decor: Heavy limb armor made of high-quality metal. With red heraldry and decorations.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorgood: Heavy chest, belly, and shoulder armor made of high-quality metal. Practically impenetrable to bites and cuts. Decorated with gold!
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorgood2: Heavy limb armor made of high-quality metal. Practically impenetrable to bites and cuts. Decorated with gold!
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorgreat: Heavy chest, stomach, and shoulder armor made of high-quality metal. Designed to be unobtrusive in combat while still looking good, but will require repairs more frequently than usual.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplatearmorgreat2: Heavy limb armor made of high-quality metal. Designed to be unobtrusive in combat while still looking good, but will require repairs more frequently than usual.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironchestplate: A breastplate made of metal plates, effectively protecting against most weapons.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironchestplatewrecked: Clearly well-used infantry armor, covered in a thick layer of rust. Impossible to repair.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmailfullerc: Chainmail for the entire body, excluding the head. Due to its holistic nature, it is stronger than its individual parts, but takes up two slots: clothing and additional armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmailfull_2_erc: Chainmail armor for the entire body, except for the head. It's quite worn and dirty, but it'll still serve well. Unfortunately, this hauberk is beyond repair.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmailfullwreckeder: Old and crumbling full-body armor. Takes up clothing and additional armor slots. Cannot be repaired.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmailerc: Armor made of segmented metal plates, sewn onto a fabric and leather base. Very effective aganist cuts and bites.
infotexts.entitydescription.brigantine2_erc: An advanced brigantine with additional shoulder padding. Very effective aganist cuts and bites.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmail_red_erc: Armor made of segmented metal plates on the torso with fabric and leather underarmor. Very effective aganist cuts and bites.
infotexts.entitydescription.brigantine_3_erc: A combination of brigandine and splint armor for the limbs. It offers excellent protection against slashing attacks but comes at a high cost and significant weight.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmail2erc: Chainmail armor for the arms, legs, and hands. Excellent protection against cuts. This model comes with plate gauntlets.
infotexts.entitydescription.chainmail3erc: Chainmail armor for the arms and legs. Provides decent protection against cuts and doesn't interfere with bow and crossbow shooting.
infotexts.entitydescription.leatherarmorerc: A durable leather vest provides protection without restricting movement.
infotexts.entitydescription.leatherarmor2erc: Leather limb armor doesn't interfere with combat, but its durability is modest, as is the area of ​​protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.leather_gloves_erc: A pair of work gloves. They're comfortable to use for hard labor and also offer some protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.leather_gloves_blacksm: Work gloves made of hardened robust leather. They speed up work at the machine a bit and offer excellent fire protection, but they become a hindrance in combat – they're too thick.
infotexts.entitydescription.steelplategauntlets: A pair of combat steel gauntlets. They're a nuisance in everyday life, but lifesaving in combat.
infotexts.entitydescription.leatherarmorheavyerc: Durable Cuirass Made of hard leather.
infotexts.entitydescription.leatherarmorheavy2erc: Despite the initially lightweight material, this protection is quite heavy.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorerc: A thick cloth shirt will provide some protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmor2erc: Very simple limb protection that does not restrict movement.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorerc_wrecked: A thick cloth shirt would provide some protection, but in this condition, it's unlikely.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmor2erc_wrecked: Very basic limb armor that doesn't restrict movement in any way, but offers terrible protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorheavyerc: Fairly durable armor made of multi-layered fabric.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmor2heavyerc: Decent fabric protection for the arms and legs; very light, though slightly heavier than ordinary cloth.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorheavyerc_wre: Vest in terrible condition. Has very low protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorheavy2erc: Armor made of multi-layered fabric, over which there is also a beautiful cape with leather straps.
infotexts.entitydescription.clotharmorheavy2rederc: Armor made of multi-layered fabric, over which there is also a beautiful cape with leather straps.
infotexts.entitydescription.goldcrownerc_1: Not the most protective helmet, but the greatest in importance. With red fabric.
infotexts.entitydescription.goldcrownerc_2: Not the most protective helmet, but the greatest in importance. With blue fabric.
infotexts.entitydescription.goldcrownerc_3: Not the most protective helmet, but the greatest in importance. With yellow fabric.
infotexts.entitydescription.goldcrownerc: Not the most protective helmet, but important - the greatest.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironlamellararmorerc: A cheap cuirass made from quilted armor. Provides acceptable protection against blows and cuts, but is still extremely weak against thrusts and slows movement slightly.
infotexts.entitydescription.riftplatearmorerc: This armor is typically worn by Rift-possessed soldiers. It is cursed and has lost some of its protective properties.
infotexts.entityname.riftplatearmor2erc: Twisted Steel Plate Bracers and Greaves
infotexts.entitydescription.riftplatearmor2erc: This armor is typically worn by Rift-possessed soldiers. It's cursed and has lost some of its protective properties.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmetrift: This helmet was found on deranged soldiers possessed by the Rift. It's worse than the undamaged version.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmetrift2: This helmet was found on deranged soldiers possessed by the Rift. Very robust for it's quality.
infotexts.entitydescription.ironhelmetrift3: This helmet was found on deranged soldiers possessed by the Rift. It looks like some kind of terrifying mask...
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_1: A distinctive beaked visor. Attached to the bascinet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_2: A visor of a heavy, modern helmet. Attached only to the armet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_3: A distinctive beaked visor with gold trim. Attaches to the bascinet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_4: A relatively flat but well-protected visor. Attaches to the bascinet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_5: A beaked, gilded visor. Practically invulnerable to cuts. Attaches to the bascinet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.visor_type_6: A flat, gilded visor. Practically invulnerable to cuts. Attaches to the bascinet; cannot be worn directly.
infotexts.entitydescription.philosophy_stone: According to legend, it can transform base metals into ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolormasterwork‖gold‖end‖ and give ‖color:gui.green‖elixir of immortality‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.quartz_skull: At the very end of the fifth cycle of the Mayan long-term calendar, it was these Skulls will help save humanity from imminent catastrophe if people figure out what to do with them. The previous four civilizations didn't and were destroyed by disasters and cataclysms...
infotexts.entitydescription.stonemask_medieval: A strange mask resembling a man's face. On the inside, it bears an inscription in an unintelligible language.
infotexts.entitydescription.magicstaff: Some kind of special stick, acts as a magical catalyst. Consumes ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorexcellent‖6 units. Mana‖end‖ per word, has ‖color:gui.orange‖average‖end‖ spell retention.
infotexts.entitydescription.magicstaff_2: Runestaff of Sustainment. Costs ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorexcellent‖7 Mana‖end‖ per word, has ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolormasterwork‖amazing‖end‖ spell retention. Damage ‖color:gui.red‖decreased by 10%‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.magicstaff_3: Rune-based scepter of attack. Costs ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorexcellent‖5 mana‖end‖ per word, has ‖color:gui.red‖poor‖spell retention. ‖color:gui.green‖ damage increased by 40%‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.grimoire: A large runebook of the sorcerer. Costs ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorexcellent‖6 mana‖end‖ per word, has ‖color:gui.green‖good‖end‖ spell retention.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_bat: A weapon that's not much different from a wood branch. Though it's quite dangerous when used to strike the head.
infotexts.entitydescription.mace: A simple blunt weapon. Very effective against armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.mace_steel: A blunt weapon with six steel plates—feathers. Extremely effective against armor and inflicts devastating injuries.
infotexts.entitydescription.spikedmace: A spiked one-handed mace. Very effective against both armor and unarmored opponents, but not particularly durable.
infotexts.entitydescription.mace_unique: A magnificent mace with a beak, inlaid with various precious stones.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbow: A fairly complex ranged weapon that effectively pierces armor. Fires crossbow bolts. Weapons skill will help load it faster. Reload only while crouched.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbow2: Smaller and less powerful version of crossbow. Fires crossbow bolts. Weapons skill will help load it faster. This one can be reloaded while moving.
infotexts.entitydescription.crossbow_unique: A special crossbow that's superior to a standard crossbow in every way, and also increases the field of view when aimed. Reload only while crouched.
infotexts.entitydescription.bow_wood_default: A classic longbow with a taut bowstring. Arrow damage depends on draw weight. It is highly dependent on the wielder's skill and can injure the hands of inexperienced warriors.
infotexts.entitydescription.bow_wood_short: A complex bow with a slack bowstring, making it quicker to draw and easier to hold. Arrow damage depends on draw weight. Less dependent on the wielder's skill.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedswordtraining: Needed for combat training. It can be used on a mannequin, but it's also great for sparring — if you hit anyone you gain combat experience up to level 80. It deals minor damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedswordiron: A slashing greatsword. Cuts well and doesn't break too quickly.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedswordsteel: A slashing great weapon. Cuts beautifully and takes a long time to dull.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedswordsteel_un: An extremely strong and sharp sword of an ancient hermit knight. This blade may become dull, but it will never break.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedspear_magical: A great spear that uses the Rift Core. Costs ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorexcellent‖7 mana‖end‖ per word, has ‖color:gui.green‖good‖end‖ spell retention.

Override.entitydescription.ceremonialsword: A slashing great weapon. You can equip two at once.

infotexts.entitydescription.mortarandpestle: Needed for crushing bones or fruits. Of course if you don’t want to stand and beat that bone against a tree.
infotexts.entitydescription.stonemortarandpestle: Needed for crushing bones or fruits. It's more durable and does the job way faster, than wooden.
infotexts.entitydescription.flourbag: Flour used to produce food. Keep out from water!
infotexts.entitydescription.grainseed: A dried fruit that doubles as a seed. Useful for stew and distillation.
infotexts.entitydescription.potato: A root vegetable from farlands. A decent food, but difficult to fry. Conveniently stored in a seed bag. It has no seeds and must be planted as such.
infotexts.entitydescription.potato_baked: This is really tasty, and it doesn't spoil quickly!
infotexts.entitydescription.potato_mixed: Potatoes with some meat and oil. Simply delicious!
infotexts.entitydescription.potato_shrub_adult: Potatoes are buried here. We need to dig them up!
infotexts.entitydescription.molotovcoctailbugurt: Intended for throwing. Light it and throw it where the enemies are. Sets the area on fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.weldingfueltankbombbug: Intended for throwing. Light it and throw it where the enemies are. Explodes violently.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_1: A small bottle of poison. This poison causes severe abdominal pain, organ failure, and often death.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_2: A small bottle of poison. This poison causes severe delirium and some organ damage, but in very small doses it reduces pain and fatigue.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_3: A small bottle of poison. This poison acts very quickly and puts the victim to sleep. It is not lethal, and a sleeping victim can be awakened if hit with something.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_4: A small vial of poison. It causes excruciating pain and respiratory distress, resulting in total paralysis. Guaranteed fatal without treatment.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_5: A small vial of poison. This poison causes severe hemorrhaging from the nose, mouth, ears—anywhere. Guaranteed fatal without treatment.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_4_1: A small vial of unfinished poison. It must be distilled to become lethal.
infotexts.entitydescription.poison_5_1: A small vial of unfinished poison. It must be distilled to become lethal.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_wood: An unremarkable wooden arrow. High stopping power only on headshots.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_bone: A wooden bow arrow with a bone tip. It is very sharp, though it does not penetrate armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_copper: A wooden bow arrow with a copper tip. Deadly to unarmored opponents.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip. Possesses weak armor-piercing properties, but decent stopping power.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip and covered in concentrated red berry poison. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted2: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip and covered in concentrated red berry poison. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted3: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip, coated with concentrated spider venom. It quickly puts its victim to sleep. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted4: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip, coated with the finest shit. Causes severe wound infection.
Деревянная стрела для лука с железным наконечником, обмазанная отборным говном. Вызывает сильное заражение ран.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted5: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip, coated in black poison. It causes fatal suffocation and pain. Multiple hits are best to ensure the poison takes effect, though a single hit may suffice.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_tainted6: A wooden bow arrow with an iron tip, coated in yellow Vanta poison. It causes profuse bleeding. Multiple hits are best to ensure the poison takes effect, though a single hit may suffice.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_steel: A wooden bow arrow with a steel awl tip. It can even pierce plate armor, but causes minor injuries.
infotexts.entitydescription.arrow_iron_burning: A special iron arrow with a flammable substance. In order to lit it you must hold this arrow near campfire or brazier.
infotexts.entitydescription.bolt: A good crossbow bolt with an iron tip. Effectively penetrates leather and chainmail armor, less so plate armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.bolt_wood: A weak wooden crossbow bolt. Good for hunting rodents or for headshots.
infotexts.entitydescription.bolt_copper: A standard crossbow bolt with a copper tip. Quite soft, but still penetrates light armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned: Improved crossbow bolt. Can infect with a disease on impact!
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned2: An iron bolt coated in poison. It can be fatal without treatment. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned3: An iron bolt coated in poison. It causes severe delirium and can be fatal. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned4: An iron bolt coated with poison. It quickly puts its victim to sleep. To guarantee poison damage, it's best to hit multiple times, although one hit may be enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned5: An iron bolt coated in venom. It causes fatal suffocation and pain. Multiple hits are best to ensure the venom takes effect, though a single hit might suffice.
infotexts.entitydescription.boltpoisoned6: An iron bolt coated in venom. It causes profuse bleeding. Multiple hits are best to ensure the venom takes effect, though a single hit might suffice.
infotexts.entitydescription.horn: Produces a very loud sound (without a tick - continuous sound, with a tick - intermittent).
infotexts.entitydescription.ram_erc: A large battering ram. It severely damages iron doors and gates in its path.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_wheel_robust: This robust wheel is suitable for a battering ram. You will need 6 of them to assemble it.
infotexts.entitydescription.ram_attackpart: A huge log, bound in iron. It is used to knock down the mightiest gates and doors. It is needed to create a battering ram.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_ram_unfinished: A battering ram can easily destroy even the strongest gates, if it can get close enough. A ram needs 6 heavy wheels to function and a battering ram head.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_wheel: Used to create a cart, but you can also roll it down a mountain for fun and see what happens.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_cart_unfinished: A cart is used to transport logs, large items, and general objects. It requires 4 wheels to function.
infotexts.entitydescription.cart_erc: Transport for logs and other heavy items.
infotexts.entitydescription.siege_shield_erc: Such a huge shield on wheels is used to protect against arrows from defenders. Sometimes it is also placed on the walls of fortresses.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_wood: Poorly suited for digging ore, but still capable of digging copper and coal deposits; weak for digging earth. Well, at least it's light.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_copper: The first metal pickaxe. Can dig iron. Falls apart fairly quickly.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_iron: An excellent excavation tool. Unfortunately, the iron pickaxe's durability isn't very high.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_bronze: The bronze pickaxe is similar in stats to the iron one, but is still more durable and does not rust in water.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_steel: The best mining tool. It will dig through any ore and dulls very slowly. It can serve as a good armor-piercing weapon, but you'll quickly get tired of swinging it around.
infotexts.entitydescription.pickaxe_gold: A suitable tool for digging up your garden. Since it is made of gold, it can harm ghosts when you hit them - unlike any other tools.
infotexts.entitydescription.axe_stone: A primitive tool designed to chop down trees. It might not even shatter into pieces. A decent weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.axe_copper: A metal tool capable of felling a tree without breaking. Not a bad weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.axe_iron: A good tool for chopping down trees. It dulls quickly, but it cuts down trees well. A dangerous weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.axe_bronze: An excellent tool for chopping wood, it's not easily dulled, and it doesn't rust from water unlike iron.
infotexts.entitydescription.axe_steel: An excellent tool for chopping down trees and heads. Very strong and sharp.
infotexts.entitydescription.battleaxe_steel: A balanced battle axe. It hits faster and harder than a standard axe, but is less effective at cutting trees and shields. Also requires repairs more frequently.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedaxe_iron: A fine tool, it can be worn on the belt slot. It is quite dangerous for trees and enemies.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedaxe_steel: An excellent tool for cutting down trees or enemy defences. It can be worn on the belt slot. Its blow is so powerful that it can pierce decent armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.dagger_bone: The most basic knife. Strikes to the head or on exhausted enemies will deal damage through light armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.dagger_copper: A fairly sharp and handy dagger. Strikes to the head or on exhausted enemies will deal damage through armor. ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorgood‖Can be poisoned.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.dagger_iron: A sharp dagger. Strikes to the head or on exhausted enemies will deal damage through tough armor. ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorgood‖Can be poisoned.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.dagger_steel: A very sharp and durable dagger. Strikes to the head or exhausted enemies will deal damage through serious armor. ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorgood‖Can be poisoned.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.cleaver_copper: This knife can be used for butchering carcasses. It wears out very quickly due to the softness of copper.
infotexts.entitydescription.cleaver_iron: A cleaver is used for butchering carcasses. It doesn't matter whether they're living or dead.
infotexts.entitydescription.shortsword_steel: An extremely sharp sword that can be conveniently carried in your inventory. It can be used as cleaver.
infotexts.entitydescription.rapier_steel: A very light and sharp thrusting sword that delivers blows with incredible speed. It breaks quickly and is unable to pierce heavy armor. Worn on the belt.
infotexts.entitydescription.falchion_iron: A sharp, curved sword. Deals massive damage to unarmored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.falchion_steel: A very sharp and durable curved sword. Deals irreparable damage to unarmored targets.
infotexts.entitydescription.falchion_gold: A less durable version of the falchion, but still quite dangerous. Designed for wearing on the belt and for displaying your status, but also can hurt ghosts because of gold.
infotexts.entitydescription.dragonslayer: It was too big to be called a sword. Massive, thick, heavy, and far too rough. Indeed, it was a heap of raw iron.
infotexts.entitydescription.magic_sword: A weightless sword of some kind of magic. It gradually disintegrates and won't last forever.
infotexts.entitydescription.magic_armor_set: Plates of some kind of energy. Absolutely weightless and don't restrict in any way, but they offer only moderate protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.magic_armor_set_evil: Blood-red armor of Rift energy. Absolutely weightless and unrestrictive, yet still offers excellent protection.
infotexts.entitydescription.hatchet_throwing_erc: Small hatchet designed to be thrown in enemy. Do not throw it point - blank, it won't do anything. Not useful as a tool. ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorgood‖Can be poisoned.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedbillhook: Polearm used to chop down small trees and bushed. It can also be used to ruin someone's day. Can chop grain bushes.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedbillhooksteel: A pole-mounted cutting weapon; its great length makes it incredibly dangerous to unprotected and, especially, slow opponents. It can sever limbs.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedhammersteel: A huge two-handed hammer with a beak. A truly terrifying weapon, but awkward to carry – it must be carried by hand.
infotexts.entitydescription.zweihandersteel: An incredibly large two-handed sword, strong and sharp. Inconvenient to carry, as it cannot even be hung on a belt. Attacks multiple targets at once.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedmacesteel: A very large and powerful steel mace. Capable of piercing even heavy armor, but heavy and slowing movement. Worn on the belt.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedspear_steel: A two-handed halberd. It can knock down even armored foe if aimed at legs. Sharp edge can pierce even metal armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.pike_steel: A very large spear used for line combat. The pike has a huge range, but it is quite heavy and will slow movement.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedspear_iron: A two-handed iron spear. Can strike at a considerable distance, but accuracy is limited at close range.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedspear_copper: A two-handed copper spear. Can strike at a considerable distance, but accuracy is limited at close range.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedspear_wood: This spear is the pinnacle of dendrological-fecal technology. If you have no metal at all, it's best not to find anything.
infotexts.entitydescription.twohandedcatcher_iron: A two-handed weapon for detaining. Deals weak damage, but can exhaust enemy effectively, especially with hits to head. If enemy is already fully exhausted, it will stun him for 5 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.spear_wood: A sharpened stick used as a spear. Despite its simplicity, this stake can give your victim a nasty surprise.
infotexts.entitydescription.spear_copper: A fairly small one-handed spear that pairs well with a shield.
infotexts.entitydescription.spear_iron: A fairly small one-handed spear that pairs well with a shield.
infotexts.entitydescription.repairkit_medieval: Repairs most equipment without requiring any skill. It's quickly consumed on items made from high-quality materials, but doesn't repair fabric clothes. Adds more wear to sharp tools than sharpening wheel.
infotexts.entitydescription.repairkit_sharpstone_m: Repairs sharp tools and weapons without any skill. Wears out tools faster than a stationary whetstone.
infotexts.entitydescription.hammer_wood: A simple hammer for construction and repair. Place a wooden plank in it to create a temporary workbench, or a log to create a fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.hammer_iron: An excellent tool for construction and repair. Can repair metal armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.hammer_iron_war: Can be used both to smash someone's face or to work on the workbench. It can be used for smithing, but it's not that convinient due to size of that hammer.
infotexts.entitydescription.plier_iron: A working tool for manipulating hot metal.
infotexts.entitydescription.awl_bone: A flimsy tool for piercing hard materials, such as tanned leather. Can repair cloth and leather armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.awl_iron: A tool for piercing hard materials, most often leather. Can repair cloth and leather armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.chisel_copper: This instrument is used in masonry.
infotexts.entitydescription.chisel_iron: This instrument is used in masonry.
infotexts.entitydescription.saw_iron: Used for the economical production of boards and other woodworking. A completely useless weapon, despite the serrated metal blade.
infotexts.entitydescription.lamp_1_erc: A small portable lamp. You can put coal in it, and it will glow.
infotexts.entitydescription.lamp_2_erc: A regular candle. It can burn and glow, but will eventually run out and go out.
infotexts.entitydescription.lamp_3_erc: A small portable lamp. It runs on any oil.
infotexts.entitydescription.woodtorcherc: A stick with coals at the end. It provides decent illumination.
infotexts.entitydescription.glassblock: Glass is primarily used for bottle production. It's incredibly fragile in its current state.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_log: A piece of fallen wood. Can be cut into planks on a sawmill or by hand, but with lesser results.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_plank: Primary building material. Keep away from fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_branch: A broken branch from a tree. Can be combined with a sharp stone to create an axe, or with a board to create a wooden hammer.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_bark: Tree bark is used to make paper, but more often it is simply tossed into the fire as kindling.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_branch_stack: A bundle of sticks for easy use in a furnace and other places that require fuel. You can add sticks to this bundle.
infotexts.entitydescription.stone1_small: This stone is easy to throw and can also be used for building.
infotexts.entitydescription.stone3_small: It can be used to cut something or someone. It can also be placed in a stick to create a primitive axe.
infotexts.entitydescription.stone2_small: These are good for hitting heads and building ovens.
infotexts.entitydescription.stonebrick: Needed for the construction of stone structures such as the crucible.
infotexts.entitydescription.stone_big: Very big stone. It contains stone and maybe something useful.
infotexts.entitydescription.stone_salt: A very large rock made of salt crystals. Usually contains salt.
infotexts.entitydescription.salt: Rock salt, used primarily for food storage. It's not very useful in its rock form yet; it should be crushed.
infotexts.entitydescription.salt_powder: A good spice for food, but primarily a vital resource for food storage.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_oil: Wood Oil is used in crafting recipes.
infotexts.entitydescription.meat_oil: Animal Oil can be used to craft shafts and for cooking.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_short: A specially prepared wooden handle for a tool or weapon.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_medium: A medium-sized, processed wooden stick used to make weapons or tools.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_long: A large pole used to make spears and the like. It's actually not bad as a weapon on its own, but it breaks quickly.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_short_bad: A small handle of poor quality, suitable for a bone awl.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_medium_bad: A small stick, suitable for a copper axe or pick, nothing more.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_shaft_long_bad: A large pole of mediocre quality, but suitable for a wooden spear.
infotexts.entitydescription.copper_nails: A handful of copper nails suitable for construction.
infotexts.entitydescription.iron_nails: A handful of high-quality iron nails suitable for any construction.
infotexts.entitydescription.leather: A small sheet of hide that needs to be processed in a tannery.
infotexts.entitydescription.leather_unique: A small sheet of incredibly strong hide. It doesn't need any more processing.
infotexts.entitydescription.leather_hardened: Hardened leather, now usable in crafting.
infotexts.entitydescription.bone_powder: Bone powder can be used as fertilizer.
infotexts.entitydescription.iron_scrap: Pieces of weapons, tools, maybe something else—it doesn't matter. Can be smelted into iron.
infotexts.entitydescription.iron_ingot: Processed iron, which can be used in more advanced tools. Can be heated in over or in crucible.
infotexts.entitydescription.iron_plate: A flat sheet of iron suitable for the production of armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_plate: A plate forged from steel, suitable for the strongest armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.steel_chainmail: Rings of steel or iron, woven into a cloth. Required for crafting high-quality armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.goldore: A large piece of precious metal, usually used for coins or jewelry.
infotexts.entitydescription.gold: A small fragment of gold. It is easy to process, so it does not even need to be formed into ingots.
infotexts.entitydescription.bronze_ingot: An alloy of copper and tin, sometimes copper and zinc. Very durable.
infotexts.entitydescription.gold_ingot: A very heavy gold ingot. It sparkles in the sun and is very pleasing to the eye.
infotexts.entitydescription.limonite: A piece of ore with slag and iron inclusions. You'll have to drag it to a furnace or kiln to extract its contents...
infotexts.entitydescription.limonite_stone: Contains limonite. You must break it first to extract its contents.
infotexts.entitydescription.berries_erc: Some delicious berries from wild bushes. Not particularly filling and don't keep very long, so best eaten right away.
infotexts.entitydescription.bee_queen: This queen is the foundation of the hive. Place her in a suitable apiary, and you'll soon have a honey-producing bee colony - if there are flowers nearby.
infotexts.entitydescription.mead_erc: These honeycombs contain delicious honey, which isn't very filling, though.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish1_erc: Excellent food! Can even be eaten raw. Will spoil if not dried or eaten.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish2_erc: Excellent food, and a big one at that! Can even be eaten raw. Will spoil if not dried or eaten.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish3_erc: A huge predatory fish. It must be gutted before consumption; otherwise, it will spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish_fillet_erc: A fish fillet ready for consumption. Can be dried. It will spoil after some time.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish_fillet_2_erc: Salted and dried pike fillet. Delicious and does not spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish1_dried_erc: Dried small Fish. Not as filling as it used to be, but it won't spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.fish2_dried_erc: A large dried fish. Not as filling as it used to be, but it won't spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.monstermeat_erc: Still fresh meat, no matter where it's from. Will spoil if not dried or eaten.
infotexts.entitydescription.monstermeat2_erc: Not fit for food! If it continues to spoil, it will turn into crap.
infotexts.entitydescription.monstermeat3_erc: Delicious food. Will spoil if not dried or eaten.
infotexts.entitydescription.humanmeat_erc: Good food for ogres or goblins. Will spoil if not eaten.
infotexts.entitydescription.humanmeat2_erc: Even an ogre wouldn't rush to eat this.
infotexts.entitydescription.humanmeat3_erc: A perfect meal for a goblin. But you're not going to eat it yourself, are you?
infotexts.entitydescription.drymeat: Dried and salted meat. Not as nutritious as fresh meat, but it doesn't spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.dryfruits: Dried fruit doesn't spoil, although it's less nutritious and filling than regular fruit.
infotexts.entitydescription.pemmican: Pemmican is a long-lasting food made from dried fruit and meat. It doesn't spoil and is quite filling.
infotexts.entitydescription.bread_erc: Good, filling food. It has very long expiration date.
infotexts.entitydescription.porrige: A plain porridge. It's okay. Will last for around 20 minutes.
infotexts.entitydescription.porrige2: Grain porridge with pieces of fruit and meat. One of the best dishes - gives experience when eaten. Will last for around 20 minutes.
infotexts.entitydescription.mead_unfinished: Mead that hasn't yet finished, and needs to be placed in the gyle.
infotexts.entitydescription.wine_unfinished: Wine that hasn't yet finished, and needs to be placed in the gyle. Ferments for a very long time.
infotexts.entitydescription.rum_unfinished: Rum that hasn't yet finished, and needs to be placed in the gyle. Ferments for a long time.
infotexts.entitydescription.beer_unfinished: Beer that hasn't yet finished fermenting, but needs to be placed in the gyle.
infotexts.entitydescription.grog: It's rum diluted in hot water. Very popular among sailors.

Override.entitydescription.diamond: A very expensive stone used in royal-grade jewelry.

infotexts.entitydescription.bread2_erc: A flour product with added poppy seeds. Very tasty, doesn't spoil!
infotexts.entitydescription.sausage_erc: A meat product with all sorts of additives. Really tasty and doesn't spoil.
infotexts.entitydescription.fishing_rod_erc: A tool for fishing in the ocean or in a ditch.
infotexts.entitydescription.fishing_rod_bad_erc: Questionable tool for fishing in the ocean or in a ditch. Will break way faster than usual.
infotexts.entitydescription.bait_fishing_erc: Fish bait. Use with a fishing rod. It's disposable, so it's a good idea to stock up on them.
infotexts.entitydescription.bait2_fishing_erc: Bait for small fish. Use with a fishing rod. Disposable and not very effective, but it's better than nothing.
infotexts.entitydescription.emptybottle: An empty glass bottle that can be collected from a bucket or dropped into a pond.
infotexts.entitydescription.waterbottle: Can be useful for making potions, but you don't want to drink it anyway.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_inprogress_gene: This potion must be distilled and is not suitable for drinking at this time.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_wasted: Half the bottle's contents have evaporated, leaving a strange, cloudy liquid.
infotexts.entitydescription.bottle_plug: It's just a stopper. What else could it be?
infotexts.entitydescription.backpack_wooden_mediev: You can hang it on your back, but it's not very comfortable. It holds 7 stacks of small items and 1 medium item.
infotexts.entitydescription.backpack_leather_medie: A large bag for carrying things on your back. More convenient than a wooden basket, but still quite heavy. It holds 6 stacks of small items and 1 medium item, also can mount any lamp.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_healing: Heals a moderate amount of wounds. Causes a moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_healing_2: Heals a large number of wounds. Causes a severe overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_power: Accelerates stamina recovery. Causes a moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_power_attack: Enhances all melee attacks. Causes a moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_power_ranged: Increases damage from bows and crossbows. Causes a low overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_power_speed: Increases movement speed. Causes a low overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_mana: Removes damage caused by Life Drain. Causes severe overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_skill: Increases all skills by 30% and increases learning speed by 30%. Causes a moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_antipoison: Effective against poisons. Simply disgusting to taste. Causes a moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_underwater: A cloudy blue tincture that allows you to breathe underwater for extended periods. The stronger the effect, the longer you can stay underwater. Causes moderate overdose.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_base_generic: Potion turned into some kind of murky, foul-smelling mess. Need to pour it out and start over.
infotexts.entitydescription.potion_base_generic2: Pour this liquid into an empty bottle to continue brewing your potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.workbench_simple_medie: A very simple production station, needed to create a workbench. Requires at least a wooden hammer for production.
infotexts.entitydescription.workbench_medieval: The main workbench for crafting wooden and other items. Requires at least a wooden hammer for production.
infotexts.entitydescription.workbench_2_medieval: Very good workbench for faster crafting wooden and other items. Requires at least a wooden hammer for production.
infotexts.entitydescription.anvil_medieval: A dense, large piece of iron used for shaping metal products. Requires at least an iron or bronze hammer for production.
infotexts.entitydescription.anvil_bronze_medieval: A dense, large piece of bronze used for shaping metal products. Requires at least an iron or bronze hammer for production.
infotexts.entitydescription.crucible_medieval: A large furnace for smelting ore and alloys. It requires bellows to work.
infotexts.entitydescription.oven_medieval: A very large furnace for baking food and smelting moderately refractory ingots.
infotexts.entitydescription.grinder_medieval: A special device for repairing sharp metal tools. Requires some blacksmithing skill to use.
infotexts.entitydescription.tanning_medieval: This rack can be used to produce leather sheets from raw hide.
infotexts.entitydescription.well_medieval: A well is needed to obtain water.
infotexts.entitydescription.well_2_medieval: More expensive well. A well is needed to obtain water, and the stone one is better in doing this.
infotexts.entitydescription.dryer_medieval: A drying rack is used to dry food and its ingredients.
infotexts.entitydescription.distiller_medieval: Needed for distilling substances and obtaining chemicals.
infotexts.entitydescription.cauldron_medieval: Potions are brewed in a cauldron. Hovewer, their recipes still need to be found... It will require any fireplace under it in order to work.
infotexts.entitydescription.gyle_medieval: The vat can be used to store wort to produce alcohol.
infotexts.entitydescription.smalldirtplanter: A small patch of soil in a square of logs. Plants need to be watered and hoeed (the greener the grass in the garden bed, the more health the plant has left!).
infotexts.entitydescription.smallwoodplanter: A wooden box for plant seedlings. Plants need to be watered, don't forget about it!
infotexts.entitydescription.wateringbucket: The bucket can store water and water plants. You need to fill the bucket with water from a well or a pond.
infotexts.entitydescription.barrel_medieval: A barrel is used to store things. It is ‖color:gui.blue‖waterproof‖end‖ and floats in water.
infotexts.entitydescription.campfire1_medieval: This is a very simple log fire. It can't be moved and burns on its own.
infotexts.entitydescription.beegarden_medieval: A small wooden house for a bee colony. To get started, you'll need a queen bee, as well as some flowers nearby. Wild poppy will be great for them!
infotexts.entitydescription.campfire2_medieval: A stone ring around a fire increases its safety and efficiency. It can be replenished with fuel. This campfire will not disappear if it runs out of fuel.
infotexts.entitydescription.altar_medieval: An altar made of stone blocks is used for offerings to the Gods. It also reacts strangely to artifacts and talismans, even broken ones...
infotexts.entitydescription.totem_medieval: A magical totem that draws power from shards of magic and radiates that power over a small area (5 - 7 meters).
infotexts.entitydescription.tailoring_medieval: A place where cloth and clothing are produced. Leather and woven armor are also made here.
infotexts.entitydescription.butchery_medieval: This hook can be used to cut up creatures into additional materials. You will need cleaver to use this.
infotexts.entitydescription.grave_medieval: You can bury a corpse here. A hoe or pickaxe is required to dig the grave, as is a pickaxe to refill it.
infotexts.entitydescription.masonry_medieval: Most stone workplaces and structures is done here. It requires at least a hammer to work here.
infotexts.entitydescription.charcoal_pit_medieval_: This special furnace is designed for producing charcoal. After installation, place 15 more planks in it, then place a burning torch in the buried pile of wood. Once it burns down, dig it up with a hoe or something better.
A finished furnace. Place a torch in it! It burns for a long time, but it produces a lot of coal.
A burnt-out charcoalburner's oven. It's full of coal, so you'll have to dig.
infotexts.entitydescription.kitchen_medieval: A stone stove similar to a oven, but with a cauldron and a flat cooking surface. It can be used to prepare complex foods.
infotexts.entitydescription.furnace_medieval: A small furnace made of bricks or something else, designed to produce bloom from iron ore. Inefficient and inconvenient – ​​it requires manual bellows.
infotexts.entitydescription.researchtable_medieval: You can obtain various blueprints and recipes there.
infotexts.entitydescription.sign_medieval_erc: You can draw something on it and place it near your shop so people know who they're dealing with.
infotexts.entitydescription.sign2_medieval_erc: You can write something on it. It stands on the ground.
infotexts.entitydescription.button_medieval: The button sends a single signal along the chain.
infotexts.entitydescription.lever_medieval: The lever sends a continuous signal along the chain.
infotexts.entitydescription.valve_medieval: When turned, sends a continuous signal down the circuit.
infotexts.entitydescription.motiondetector_medieva: When stepped on, sends a continuous signal down the circuit.
infotexts.entitydescription.periscope_medieval: Connects via a chain to a mechanism to set its position. Useful for adjusting the aim of mounted weapons, such as a mounted crossbow.
infotexts.entitydescription.wire_medieval_metal: The chain is used to connect levers to doors and other things. Extends up to 3 meters.
infotexts.entitydescription.beartrap: Used for catching forest game. Reload at a workbench.
infotexts.entitydescription.goblintrap1: Useless against anyone but humans. ‖color:gui.itemqualitycolorgood‖Can be additionaly poisoned.‖end‖
infotexts.entitydescription.goblintrap2: Doesn't kill, but heavily damages people running past. Won't work if you're walking too slowly.
infotexts.entitydescription.spidertrap1: It hinders movement and alerts the spider to a nearby threat.
infotexts.entitydescription.container_wood_2_old_e: They hold 12 items, that's all. A slightly different option.
infotexts.entitydescription.container_wood_1_erc: Holds 16 items and one large one, like waistbag or quiver.
infotexts.entitydescription.container_wood_5_erc: Holds 35 items and 3 larger ones, such as chests, weapons, or bags.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_wood_1_erc: Holds 9 items. Doesn't drop items when picked up.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_wood_2_erc: Small crate that holds an item. It's locked and must be broken first.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_wood_3_erc: Can be disguised as various items. Holds only 4 items, but is difficult to find.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_vase_erc: Vase that contains something. You need to destroy it to obtain contained items.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_iron_1_erc: Holds 12 items. Doesn't drop items when picked up.
infotexts.entityname.crate_iron_locked_generic_erc: Iron Chest (With Lock, not yet locked)
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_iron_locked_gene: Will hold 12 items when locked. Does not drop items when picked up. You must place the desired key inside to complete the lock.
infotexts.entitydescription.crate_iron_locked_lock: Holds 12 items. Does not drop items when picked up. It's locked with some kind of key, but it can be lockpicked at a workbench.
infotexts.entitydescription.weaponrack_single_iron: Hold one weapon, including any bow. Can be attached to wall.
infotexts.entitydescription.table1_wooden_erc: A simple table. You can place a couple of items on top.
infotexts.entitydescription.table2_wooden_erc: A simple, large table. You can place several items on top.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair1_wooden_erc: When there's not much work to do (and that's never the case), you can sit and relax. Provides a skill boost to tailoring, crafting, and alchemy, as well as to their progression.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair2_wooden_erc: This isn't exactly a chair, but a very comfortable chair. Provides a significant skill boost to tailoring, crafting, and alchemy, as well as to their progression.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair3_wooden_erc: Not exactly a comfortable place to sit It's not much for gatherings, but it's better than nothing.
infotexts.entitydescription.shelf1_wooden_erc: Displays up to 4 items. Can be hung on the wall.
infotexts.entitydescription.shelf2_wooden_erc: Displays up to 4 items. Can be hung on the wall.
infotexts.entitydescription.shelf3_wooden_erc: Holds up to 12 books, recipes, or papers. Can be hung on the wall.
infotexts.entitydescription.wood_manequin: Used for practicing melee skills. It won't improve skill beyond 40 and causes fatigue during training.
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_1: You have to sleep sometime! This bed is quite comfortable.
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_2: You have to sleep sometime! This bed is quite comfortable.
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_3: You have to sleep sometime! This bed is uncomfortable!
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_4: A normal bed with two beds. Cannot be placed during gameplay.
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_5: The folded tent. It can be taken with you and used as a bed, allowing you to rest even far from home.
infotexts.entitydescription.ladder_medieval_usable: This ladder allows you to climb quite high! Must be placed before use.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair1_stone_erc: An expensive stool that's also uncomfortable to sit on.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair2_stone_erc: A chair with a back. It's not exactly comfortable to sit on the stone, but there are small cushions for comfort.
infotexts.entitydescription.chair3_stone_erc: A grand throne for a lord, perhaps even an emperor.
infotexts.entitydescription.sarcophagus_medieval: A noble stone tomb for an very influential person.
infotexts.entitydescription.table1_stone_erc: A fine stone table Holds 5 items. Damn heavy.
infotexts.entitydescription.table2_stone_erc: A solid stone table that holds 9 items. It's so heavy!
infotexts.entitydescription.table3_stone_erc: A large stand for just one item. However, it can hold even medium-sized items, such as armor.
infotexts.entitydescription.bed_6: A noble bed made of stone blocks. It's quite cold, but perfect for hot weather.
infotexts.entitydescription.mushroom_erc: A common mushroom that can be eaten. It spoils in 15 minutes.
infotexts.entitydescription.mushroom_cooked_erc: Tasty mushroom that can be safely eaten. It spoils in 15 minutes.
infotexts.entitydescription.mushroom_dried_erc: A dried edible mushroom. It doesn't spoil anymore, but it's not as nutritious as it used to be.
infotexts.entitydescription.mushroom2_erc: These are not usually eaten. It spoils in 15 minutes.
infotexts.entitydescription.mushroom2_dried_erc: Dried red mushroom. Nice component to make a poison...
infotexts.entitydescription.nettle_shrub: This bush stings! You feel like this bush is begging you to beat it with a stick.
infotexts.entitydescription.nettle: It doesn't sting as much, but it still itchy. Can be grinded into powder.
infotexts.entitydescription.nettle_powder: Used by healers for their research.
infotexts.entitydescription.nettlesoup: Quite tasty, though not particularly filling.
infotexts.entitydescription.tobacco_powder: It can be smoked in a pipe. It has a calming effect and helps to think more clearly.
infotexts.entitydescription.berryshrub2: Berries grow on this bush, but for some reason they are red.
infotexts.entitydescription.fiberplant_shrub: Fiberplant it great source of threads.
infotexts.entitydescription.aquaticpoppy_shrub: You can take it and obtain poppy.
infotexts.entitydescription.yeastshroom_shrub: You can take it and obtain yeast shroom. It grows only in water.
infotexts.entitydescription.grain_shrub: Grain grows here. When it finally grows, it's ready to harvest.
infotexts.entitydescription.grain_shrub_adult: Grain grows here. It can be finally harvested.
infotexts.entitydescription.creepingorange_shrub_a: Creeping orange grows here. It can be finally harvested.
infotexts.entitydescription.smalltree: A common sapling that will one day grow into a large tree if planted in the ground.
infotexts.entitydescription.smalltree_winter: A common sapling that will one day grow into a large winter tree if planted in the ground.
infotexts.entitydescription.bigshrub: It's very easy to hide here; simply crouching down is enough.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_broken_copper: Piece of copper talisman. In very bad condition, but somehow you know it was very important.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_golden: A beautiful talisman made of pure gold with a lazulite in center. It is said to bring good luck.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_1: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts a warrior slaying monsters.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_2: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts a lion entwined with a snake.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_3: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts some kind of sorcerer in the center.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_4: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts a triangular shield.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_5: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It's hard to figure out what it does.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_6: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts a dragon.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_7: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It depicts a snake wrapped around a skull.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_8: Some kind of very expensive talisman. In the center is an engraving of a bull looking straight forward.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_9: Some kind of very expensive talisman. It's an ornate blue, and it depicts lord Brendon Chekevich. You feel a sense of comfort when looking at it.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_10: Some kind of very expensive, but worn talisman. It's unclear whether this wear is necessary for its special abilities, and it looks extremely flimsy.
infotexts.entitydescription.talisman_11: Some kind of very expensive talisman. In the middle of it there is something like an eye behind glass, and sometimes it moves...
infotexts.entitydescription.flag_generic: Flags are used by kingdoms, armies, and merchants to identify themselves. In addition to the color, the flag can be customized with a background and an emblem while holding it in your hands.
infotexts.entitydescription.dice_1_erc: It can be rolled, and then it will show an unpredictable result. It faces one towards you.
infotexts.entitydescription.dice_2_erc: It can be rolled, and then it will show an unpredictable result. It faces two towards you.
infotexts.entitydescription.dice_3_erc: It can be rolled, and then it will show an unpredictable result. It faces three toward you.
infotexts.entitydescription.dice_4_erc: It can be rolled, and then it will show an unpredictable result. It faces four toward you.
infotexts.entitydescription.dice_5_erc: It can be rolled, and then it will show an unpredictable result. It faces five towards you.

infotexts.entitydescription.book_potions_medieval: This book lists all known potion recipes. You will need a cauldron, and sometimes a distiller.
infotexts.terminalwelcomemsg.book_potions_medieval:
This book describes all known concoctions that you can brew yourself.
Follow the recipe carefully, and the brew will turn out to be of excellent quality!
Each potion can be brewed to its absolute limit, but most also have recommended timeframes. If you finish the potion at the wrong moment, you could ruin everything! So, if you're unsure, wait for it to finish brewing on its own.

Healing Draught
A healing draught helps with bodily wounds. It does not, however, stop bleeding. You will need: - Bottle - Bone meal - Vial of opium
1. Toss the opium into the cauldron 2. Toss the bone meal into the cauldron 3. Begin brewing 4. Pour into the bottle
If necessary, it can be processed in a distiller; this will only improve the draught.
If you brew it for exactly one turn of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Restorative Draught
A restorative draught helps with severe bodily wounds. It does not, however, stop bleeding. This draught carries a high risk of overdose; drink wisely. You will need: - Healing draught - Calcium powder
1. Add calcium powder to the draught 2. Distill

Stamina Draught
This draught helps you catch your breath faster in the heat of battle, making it indispensable for warriors. You will need: - A Bottle - Alcohol - Wood oil
1. Add alcohol to the cauldron 2. Add wood oil to the cauldron 3. Start brewing 4. Pour into the bottle
If necessary, you can run it through a distiller; this will only improve the concoction.
If you brew it for exactly one turn of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Potion of Great Strength
This potion makes a warrior significantly stronger in combat. The more you drink, the more noticeable the effect. You will need: - Stamina Potion - Black metal or crushed uranium
1. Add the ingredient to the potion 2. Distill

Archer's Potion
This potion enhances a fighter's visual acuity and ranged damage. As a side effect, the warrior will strike more accurately—and thus more powerfully—with spears. You will need: - Stamina Potion - Green sodium powder
1. Add the ingredient to the potion 2. Distill

Hermes' Potion
This potion increases movement speed. The more you drink, the stronger the effect. You will need: - Stamina-restoring concoction - Dried fruit or dried meat
1. Toss the ingredient into the concoction 2. Distill

Mana-restoring concoction
This concoction is needed by mages who have exhausted themselves through frequent spellcasting. You will need: - Bottle - Purple lithium powder - Crushed zinc or gold
1. Toss zinc or gold into the cauldron 2. Carefully add the lithium powder 3. Begin brewing 4. Pour into a bottle and distill
If you brew it for exactly two turns of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Concoction of Great Intellect
Craftsmen use this concoction to create true masterpieces, while the wealthy use it to learn a craft. You will need: - Bottle - Green sodium powder - Dried meat
1. Toss dried meat into the cauldron 2. Add the sodium 3. Begin brewing 4. Pour into a bottle and distill
If you brew it for exactly two turns of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Antidote
If you have been poisoned by something nasty, this antidote will quickly purge the ailment. You will need: - Bottle - Alcohol - Blue chlorine powder
1. Toss the chlorine into the cauldron 2. Pour in the alcohol 3. Start brewing 4. Pour into a bottle and distill
If you brew it for exactly two turns of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Water Breathing
This concoction allows you to stay underwater like a fish. You will need: - Bottle - Any fish - Blue chlorine powder
1. Add the fish to the cauldron 2. Toss the chlorine into the cauldron 3. Start brewing 4. Pour into a bottle and distill
If you brew it for exactly one turn of the hourglass, you will get twice as much usable potion!

Black Toxin
Causes excruciating pain, suffocation, and death. Can only be cured by an antidote! You will need: - Red berry poison - Two handfuls of green sodium powder - A vial of opium
1. Add the red berry poison to the cauldron 2. Add the opium to the cauldron 3. Brew for exactly one turn of the hourglass 4. Drain from the cauldron 5. Distill with two piles of green powder

Vanta Poison
A poison capable of killing even a great lord. Causes irreversible hemorrhaging from all organs. Can only be cured by an antidote! You will need: - Fly agaric poison - Hide of a great beast - Three handfuls of copper
1. Add the fly agaric poison to the cauldron 2. Toss the hide of the fearsome beast into the cauldron 3. Brew for exactly two turns of the hourglass 4. Drain from the cauldron 5. Distill with three handfuls of copper
